process_issues.description: Every Bash call failed before running (including `gh pr view 234`, `git diff --stat b98e363e570950d767f01e0eda328c372b256f3e..HEAD` and `git rev-parse HEAD`) with: `apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied`. The sandbox's seccomp/user-namespace setup can't start on this runner, and the sandbox can't be turned off in this configuration. Without it the PR diff, metadata, threads and head SHA could not be read.

No reviewers were spawned, so PR #234 was NOT reviewed and this record must not be read as a clean review. Subagents share the same Bash sandbox, so they could not have read the diff either. Reviewing the current files without a diff would have meant guessing which lines the PR added. Re-run once the runner can start the bubblewrap/seccomp sandbox (it needs unprivileged user namespaces / CAP_SYS_ADMIN for setgroups).
